nodes.g: Zethar = "star" one of the seven eunuchs of Ahasuerus
Abagtha = "God-given" one of the seven eunuchs in the Persian court of Ahasuerus
Jachan = "troublesome" one of seven chief men of the tribe of Gad
Pleiades, a constellation of seven stars
Jemima = "day by day" one of the daughters of Job born after the restoration
Keren-happuch = "horn of antimony" one of the daughters of Job born after his trial
seven, period of seven (days or years), heptad, week
